ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aarti Industries Limited is undertaking a material fundraise of up to ₹1,000 Crore primarily to repay outstanding borrowings, aiming to significantly reduce leverage and interest costs, which should enhance its financial flexibility. This strategic deleveraging follows a period of robust operational performance, evidenced by an impressive 58.2% year-on-year increase in EBITDA and a 117.4% rise in PAT for H1 FY27. While no immediate red flags are apparent, the company's focus on commissioning new facilities like Zone IV and pursuing strategic JVs underscores its commitment to expanding capabilities and capitalizing on the growing specialty chemicals market.
